export default "# Can't see cards? Wonky board?\nTry zooming out on your browser by pressing `Ctrl -` (Windows/Linux) or `Cmd -` (Mac). Reset zoom with `Ctrl 0` or `Cmd 0`.\n\n# Need more help?\nJoin our Discord (https://discord.gg/PgH2gVZYKq) and reach out!\n\n# Getting Started\n\n## Inviting Friends to Play\n\nTo play with friends, simply **copy your browser's URL** and send it to them. When they open the link, they'll join your game room automatically.\n\nExample: `https://aura-dqp.pages.dev/?room=mtg-abc123`\n\n---\n\n## Importing Decks\nWe support Moxfield's MTGO export format. We can't promise that anything else will work. The format is: \n[quantity] [card name], e.g. 1 Mountain\n\n### Commander and Command Zone\nTo have your commander drawn into your hand automatically, place your commander as the last card in your import list.\nWe plan to support deck editing in the near future.\n\n---\n\n## Multiplayer Features\n\n### 3+ Players\n\n- **Hover** over an opponent's health display to temporarily view their board at full opacity\n- **Click** on an opponent's health display to **pin** their board (keeps it visible)\n- Click again to unpin\n\n### Adding Opponent Counters\n\nHover an opponent and click the **+** on the left side of their health box.\n\n---\n\n## Zoom Controls\n\nThe app has three separate zoom controls located around the screen:\n\n### Card Preview Zoom (Middle Left)\n- Controls the size of the enlarged card preview that appears when hovering over cards\n- **+** to zoom in, **−** to zoom out\n- Click the zoom level to reset to 1.0×\n\n### Hand Card Zoom (Bottom Left)\n- Controls the size of cards in your hand at the bottom of the screen\n- **+** to zoom in, **−** to zoom out\n- Click the zoom level to reset to 1.0×\n\n### Battlefield Card Zoom (Middle Right)\n- Controls the size of all cards on the battlefield\n- **+** to zoom in, **−** to zoom out\n- Click the zoom level to reset to 1.0×\n\n---\n\n## Basic Gameplay\n\n### Drawing Cards\n- Press **C** to draw a card from your deck to your hand\n\n### Playing Cards\n- **Drag** a card from your hand to the battlefield\n- **Drag** cards on the battlefield to move them around\n\n### Board Actions\n\nWhen hovering over a card on the battlefield:\n- **Space** - Tap/Untap the card\n- **F** - Flip the card face-down/face-up\n- **U** - Add a +1/+1 counter\n- **I** - Add a -1/-1 counter\n- **K** - Create a copy of the card\n\n### Card Movement\n\nWhen hovering a card:\n- **D** - Move to discard pile (graveyard)\n- **S** - Move to exile pile\n- **T** - Move to top of deck\n- **Y** - Move to bottom of deck\n- **H** - Return to hand (when hovering over discard/exile piles)\n\n### Other Actions\n- **V** - Shuffle your deck\n- **M** - Mulligan (shuffle hand into deck and draw a new hand)\n- **X** - Untap all your cards\n- **+ or =** - Gain 1 life\n- **- or _** - Lose 1 life\n\n---\n\n## Viewing Piles\n\nClick on any pile (Deck, Discard, Exile) to view its contents. You can use keyboard shortcuts while hovering over \ncards in these piles, for example, you can move a discarded card back into your hand by hovering and pressing **H**.\n"
